title: Karis Nemik
description: Karis Nemik belonged to Vel Sartha's team for the Aldhani heist. A skilled navigator, he also took part in planning the heist. Nemik was among the team members that got away after the job. however, the heavy weight of the stolen credits fell onto Nemik, doing him serious bodily harm. Sartha found medical help for Nemik, but he died from his injuries.
